purpose: Test whether much broader M15-H4 state opportunity pools can be converted into robust high-count candidates through composite loser subtraction or score-based coverage selection.

broad_pools.note: Composite loser leaves improved the pool but did not make it independently profitable in both 2024 and 2025.
The broad state had strong regime dependence and failed the multi-year robustness gate.

loss_model_screen.selection_rule: 2024 and 2025 must each have at least 100 trades, PF above 1.05, and positive total R
loss_model_screen.interpretation: High trade count alone does not create edge. A broad directional state must be combined with a meaningful event or regime structure before loser subtraction.

additional_rule_audit.rule: H1-D1 LONG using D1 MACD histogram SMA4 normalized by D1 ATR and H1 24-hour delta normalized by H1 ATR
additional_rule_audit.note: Pre-2026 strength did not persist, and pre-2026 loser filters did not repair the 2026 diagnostic.

next_search_adjustment: start from broad event-trigger pools rather than direction-sign states
include breakout, failed-break, pullback-completion, volatility-transition, and session events
apply composite loser subtraction after event generation
keep annual count as an explicit optimization constraint
test 1.0R, 1.5R, 2.0R and multiple horizons as separate lineages
